artifact:
Feature: Hospital Staff Requirements and Feedback

  Scenario: Hospital Staff Identifies Information
    Given the Hospital Staff is logged in
    When the Hospital Staff receives information from Patients, Chemists, and Labs
    Then the Hospital Staff should be able to identify and record the information

  Scenario: Hospital Staff States Requirements
    Given the Hospital Staff is logged in
    When the Hospital Staff states the requirements of the software
    Then the Hospital Staff should be able to input the requirements

  Scenario: Hospital Staff Provides Feedback
    Given the Hospital Staff is logged in
    When the Hospital Staff provides feedback on the software requirements
    Then the Hospital Staff should be able to submit the feedback

  Scenario: Hospital Staff References Requirements Document
    Given the Hospital Staff is logged in
    When the Hospital Staff accesses the requirements document
    Then the Hospital Staff should be able to view the document as a reference

  Scenario: Project Management and Development Team Analyzes Requirements
    Given the Project Management and Development Team is logged in
    When the Project Management and Development Team analyzes the requirements document
    Then the Project Management and Development Team should be able to understand the requirements

  Scenario: Project Management and Development Team Designs System
    Given the Project Management and Development Team is logged in
    When the Project Management and Development Team designs the system based on the requirements
    Then the Project Management and Development Team should be able to create a design document

  Scenario: Project Management and Development Team Implements System
    Given the Project Management and Development Team is logged in
    When the Project Management and Development Team implements the system based on the design
    Then the Project Management and Development Team should be able to deploy the system
